chunk_map.heading: "The agent got this wrong" costs nobody face

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L6: "That makes the sentence cheap to say" - 'That' resolves to the L4 contrast in the same chunk, 'the sentence' to the quoted header phrase; no harm (unresolvable referent) present.

rules_evaluated.na_reason: no pointer to another file or earlier slide

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: L4-8: three paragraphs carry a claim (naming the agent spares a person), a condition (stay cheap for newest person and lead's agent) and a move (say it early); closest to orphan is L8 but it is the slide's ask.
L1 header 'costs nobody face' vs L4 'what gets questioned is the agent's output, not a person' - body supports the header literally.
grep for 'Not X. Not Y.' triples, anaphora, superlatives, verb triplets in L4-8 -> none; closest L4 'the agent's output, not a person' is a single contrast inside one sentence, not the banned triple.

rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -ciE 'surface|compendium|forcing function|beat|mood' on L1-8 -> 0; 'squint slide' appears only in the maintainer block L12.

rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '\*\*' on body L1-8 -> 0 (bold only in maintainer block L12).
